part.text:
Done. All 1315 gson tests pass (19 skipped, pre-existing).

Changes to `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/GsonBuilder.java`:
- `registerTypeAdapter` (GsonBuilder.java:679) now throws `IllegalArgumentException("Cannot override built-in adapter for " + type)` when the type is `Object`, `JsonElement`, or a `JsonElement` subclass
- `registerTypeHierarchyAdapter` (GsonBuilder.java:807) throws the same exception for `JsonElement`/subclasses (registering for `Object` remains allowed, as the existing test requires)
- Added helper `isJsonElementType(Type)` using `TypeToken.get(type).getRawType()`
- Extended javadoc for both methods documenting the restriction and suggesting `@JsonAdapter` as an alternative

The matching tests `testRegisterTypeAdapterForObjectAndJsonElements` and `testRegisterTypeHierarchyAdapterJsonElements` in GsonBuilderTest now pass, with no regressions elsewhere in the suite.
